name: Legs Up Bench Press (Barbell)
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your feet raised and knees bent, holding the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Retract your shoulder blades and brace your core.
Lower the bar to your mid-chest.
Press the bar back up to full extension.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A flat bench press with the feet up on the bench or in the air, reducing leg drive and lower-back arch.

safetyNotes: Use a spotter or safeties; use a lighter weight than a normal bench press.
